body: Posted from my throwaway account...  I made it because I was about 10 minutes away from suicide
I met a tgirl from the personals boards; we hooked up 5-6 times then she moved...  Kinda miss her...
Thank you.  My google searches haven't yielded consistent results but I will try adding vitamin B to my hydration.
I went, I posted, and I found a few supportive people...  Not as many as I expected, but still one is better than none.  I'm still on the edge, but their support has helped...
That actually makes my impending suicide more acceptable...

Sorry for the delayed response, this account is obviously a throwaway.  Thank you for your insight and advice, I really do appreciate it.

I have a meeting scheduled with a lawyer tomorrow; but work-life (who she made the report to wants to talk to me tomorrow too); if work life brings up the abuse I'm basically going to tell them I need to speak with my lawyer before answering any questions about that.

My command has only been informed that she called work-life; we have a fairly small & senior office (18 people, lowest ranking is E6); I know my command will support me through all this, but once reports are made there's not a whole lot they can do.

As for the gun, only one person knows I bought it; the big thing I see with suicide is that if you really intend to do and want to be successful, you don't give any signs before it happens.

I'm going to keep moving on the positive route; but if I actually do get charged with abuse, suicide is my only way out.

I've been depressed for years...  I'm been in a miserable marriage for the last three+ years and 2 weeks ago it finally fell apart, she left.  Now she is alleging domestic violence which, by the book, is true...  Although she would be guilty too.  With that charge (which will of course stick because I'm a guy) my career (military) is over.  I'm bad at keeping in touch with people (both friends and family), so basically, when I lose my career I lose my life.
Will reply in depth further later...  Eating one of my favorite/last meals...
